questions.stem: In a triangle $OAB$, $\overrightarrow{OA} = \mathbf{a}$ and $\overrightarrow{OB} = \mathbf{b}$. Express $\overrightarrow{AB}$ in terms of $\mathbf{a}$ and $\mathbf{b}$.
questions.explanation: To go from $A$ to $B$, first go from $A$ to $O$ (which is $-\mathbf{a}$) and then from $O$ to $B$ (which is $\mathbf{b}$). So $\overrightarrow{AB} = -\mathbf{a} + \mathbf{b} = \mathbf{b} - \mathbf{a}$.
